items.title: Nestlé sold more than expected this summer
items.summary: Nestlé outperformed expectations in the third quarter. The Swiss food giant is benefiting from a strong recovery in sales volumes, particularly in emerging markets. Pet food and snacks are driving growth, while the impact of the large-scale baby food recall is gradually…

items.title: Kroger bets on lower prices and simpler deals to drive growth
items.summary: Kroger’s growth strategy includes a $5 billion investment in customer value through 2029, with lower prices, simpler promotions and more store brands.

items.title: Fnac Darty grows despite unrest in France
items.summary: Fnac Darty posted a 1.8% increase in revenue on a comparable basis in the third quarter. Results were driven primarily by European markets outside France and online sales. The electronics retailer has confirmed its full-year forecast, despite the recent looting of French stores.

items.title: Albert Heijn: delivery service won’t be back to full capacity until next week
items.summary: Albert Heijn is gradually recovering from the cybersecurity incident on October 11. In the Netherlands, the first customers can once again order groceries online, while home delivery in Belgium will resume on Monday. However, several digital savings and discount promotions…

items.title: Nestlé turnaround accelerates as volume growth gains pace
items.summary: Nestlé reported strong Q3 2026 results, with volume growth accelerating, emerging markets outperforming and confidence growing in its turnaround strategy.

items.title: Nestlé Beats Sales Forecasts As It Excludes Seized Russian Business
items.summary: Nestlé beat third-quarter organic sales growth forecasts and excluded its Russian unit from group accounts after Moscow seized the business.

items.title: Quality Street gets Monopoly makeover amid collaboration craze
items.summary: Nestlé Quality Street and Monopoly join forces for Christmas as confectionery brands turn to partnerships to drive engagement, relevance and sales.

items.title: PepsiCo’s Good Warrior enters protein bar space
items.summary: The snacking giant is boosting the protein content in several brands, with more than half of consumers prioritizing the nutrient during snacking occasions.

items.title: Danone partners on $40M facility turning yogurt waste to renewable energy
items.summary: The project, commissioned by PurposeEnergy, comes as the dairy giant boosts production to meet accelerating demand for high-protein yogurt.

items.title: Mars joins Hershey and Ferrero in race for the digital impulse purchases
items.summary: Snickers and M&M’s manufacturer Mars launches its shoppable Instagram channel, highlighting how brands are increasingly treating social platforms as the next impulse-purchase aisle.

items.title: Carrefour opens another five autonomous BuyBye stores
items.summary: With the opening of two new autonomous BuyBye stores in Belgium and three in France, Carrefour will soon have 12 locations featuring this innovative, AI-powered unstaffed retail concept.

items.title: Maxi Zoo opts for a Benelux structure
items.summary: Fressnapf, the parent company of Maxi Zoo, is consolidating its operations in Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg into a new Benelux cluster led by Giane Van Landuyt, who until now has served as country manager for Belgium.

items.title: Thierry Garnier will take office as CEO of Ahold Delhaize on March 3
items.summary: Thierry Garnier, who is currently the CEO of the Kingfisher home improvement group, will assume the roles of president, Chief Executive Officer (CEO), and member of the Board of Directors of Ahold Delhaize on March 3, 2027.

items.title: Boparan To Invest £100m In British Turkey Amid Rising Demand
items.summary: 2 Sisters Food Group owner Boparan Private Office plans to invest £100 million (€119.3 million) in British turkey production.

items.title: UK's Sainsbury's Follows Tesco In Lifting Profit Outlook
items.summary: Sainsbury's upgraded the lower end of its full-year profit outlook after posting a 3.6% rise for its first half.

items.title: Salling Group’s Føtex Pilots Humanoid Robots
items.summary: Danish grocery chain Føtex and tech start-up HIVE have started training humanoid robots to restock grocery shelves after hours.

items.title: EU Maize Imports Soar 40% After Drought Ravages Crops, Soft Wheat Exports Stable
items.summary: EU maize imports in the 2026/27 season jumped 40% year on year by 18 October, led by a more than threefold rise in shipments from the US.

items.title: UK Inflation And Borrowing Climb Before Healey’s First Budget Wednesday
items.summary: UK inflation and borrowing exceeded forecasts, adding pressure for household support in next week's budget and a Bank of England rate hike.

items.title: Allplants sold to French food manufacturer
Christmas loan (temporarily) saves Galeria from the axe
items.summary: The struggling German department store chain Galeria has signed a major financing agreement with the American retail turnaround firm Gordon Brothers. The loan ensures that the store will be stocked for the crucial end-of-year period, but at what cost?

items.title: Kuehne+Nagel Lifts 2026 Outlook After A Robust Third Quarter
items.summary: Kuehne+Nagel raised its 2026 operating profit guidance for the third time this year, after reporting robust third-quarter results.

items.title: Croatia’s Tommy Group Plans To Raise €200m From IPO
items.summary: Croatian retailer and food producer Tommy Group is moving forward with an IPO, aiming to raise €180-200 million.

items.title: Serbia Launches Real-Time Price Comparison Platform For Retailers
items.summary: Serbia’s Ministry of Internal and Foreign Trade has launched a digital platform to let citizens monitor and compare retail prices.

items.title: Abbott plans to spin out its nutrition business
items.summary: The Ensure and Pedialyte owner said the move would allow it to better capitalize on growing demand for functional nutritition.

items.title: When will El Niño peak?
items.summary: El Niño is expected to be the biggest since the 19th century. When will the weather event peak, how will this affect the food sector, and how can FMCGs prepare?

items.title: Cherry Or Tabasco? Perfumers Test Weight-Loss Drug Users' Appetite For Food-Inspired Scents
items.summary: Some perfume makers are starting to ask if weight-loss drugs might be reshaping what consumers want in a scent.

items.title: Walmart Launches $120 Membership Bundle With Sam's Club Ahead Of Holidays
items.summary: Walmart launched a $120-a-year bundle combining its Walmart+ and Sam's Club Plus memberships, offering shoppers a discount of nearly $100.

items.title: The new rules of climate-smart food
items.summary: Climate Smart Food 2026: Industry leaders share how resilience, technology and farmer support are shaping the future of sustainable food

items.title: Magic trading cards perform miracles for Hasbro
items.summary: Toy manufacturer Hasbro exceeded expectations with 15% revenue growth and a 52% jump in profits in the third quarter. The card game *Magic: The Gathering* in particular is proving to be a gold mine. The U.S. company is raising its full-year forecast.

items.title: Philip Morris Warns Conflicts Are Raising Costs, Hurting Earnings
items.summary: Philip Morris expects profit in the middle to lower half of its forecast range amid pressure from Middle East and Ukraine conflicts.

items.title: Chocolate has a new problem. And it’s not cocoa prices
items.summary: Rising temperatures are reshaping the chocolate industry, impacting both cocoa supplies and consumer demand. As heatwaves become more frequent, manufacturers are adapting formats, product strategies and retail approaches to protect sales in a warming world.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize’s U.S. websites are also back online
items.summary: Following last week's cyber incident, the websites and apps of the American supermarket chains belonging to the Ahold Delhaize Group are once again operational.

items.title: What neuroscience reveals about functional bread
items.summary: How brain activity measurements could help bakers understand reactions to functional bread’s texture, flavour and nutritional messaging.

items.title: Exposing the mistakes that sink healthier snacks
items.summary: Explore how taste expectations, formulation compromises and supplier reliability can derail healthier snacks – and what manufacturers should assess.
